load.custom_size: Enter the length and width of the load.
load.too_wide: The load is wider than the cargo space.
load.deck_unknown: Enter the cargo space length (or pallet places in the vehicle profile).
load.overweight: Load of {weight} kg exceeds the payload of {payload} kg.
load.cog_front: The load's centre of gravity is too far forward ({share}% of the length) – move heavier pallets back so as not to overload the fifth wheel.
load.cog_back: The load's centre of gravity is too far back ({share}% of the length) – move heavier pallets forward so the steering axle keeps its load.
load.no_front_wall: The load does not rest against the front wall – more straps are needed (braking).
load.axle_over: Axle load exceeded: {axle} {load} kg, {limit} kg allowed – move the load or reduce the weight.
load.adjusted: The load was rearranged so as not to exceed the axle loads.
load.gap_front: The load is {gap} m away from the front wall – block it at the front (beam, airbag) or add straps.
load.too_high: A stack is higher than the cargo space (about {height} m).
load.overlap: Pieces overlap – move the pallets apart.
